reason: I'd maybe download the free version and use the doctor PDF, but I'm not paying $5 a month for an AI write-up when I already log stuff in Apple Health and notes. I never pay for apps, and I'd just cancel after a trial anyway.
objection: An app won't change what my doctor does. A summary of my own log doesn't tell me if metformin or inositol is actually working, and Pro features like breathing exercises and backup aren't things I'd pay for.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor actually used the Cyra report and it got them to change my treatment or take my symptoms more seriously, I might pay for it, but probably only a few dollars a year.
